main_text.l: Sunt & Apollo mihi, Nymphaq; Coronide nati, Queis delubra magis constituenda reor. Nulla Chelys tā docta fuit, nulla arsq; medendi, Quale opus est medicum docte RODOL- PHE tuum, Quale parentis opus, quo conciliauit amicè Dissimiles inter se, similesq; Sophos. Dicite Pierides lauro hic, an dignior ille? Et lauro hic dignus, dignus & ille fuit. Non bene conueniunt discrimina dissona voci, Nec nisi concordi pectine grata lyra est: Sic nisi conueniant sapientum linguaq;, mensq;, Gratia quanta fuit, gratia tanta perit. Talis inest Patri sapientia, visq; docendi, Per quem iam coeunt, quæ coitura negès. Qualis inest Gnato prudentia, visq; medendi, Per quem sanantur, quæ moritura putes. Et quia non tantum laudatur acumine Pallas, Quantum laudata est Vtilitate Dea, Vnde oleæ inuentrix celebratur dia Minerua, Vsibus humanis commoda multa ferens:

page.notes: Verse printed in italic type; the ligature "Nymphaq;" and "Sophos" as printed. Hard words in the first and eighth lines are read from a worn scan; the spelling "Vsibus" and "Vnde" follow the print. Some letters near the right edge of the page are faded.
